design.decision: Once your contract is safe, or hopeless, play to set the opponents rather than to win spare tricks.
design.opponent: Shown when the opponents are first set. After that the opponents bid more carefully against this team.
design.rationale: This adds a new scoring axis, defence, that gives overtricks a purpose again without changing bid rules. The multiplier applies even if this team is set, so it is double-edged.
design.draftText: +15 contract multiplier if the opponents miss their contract

history.note: draft-common: the enumerator also produced this signature (e-oppset-mult); credited to both sources.
